name: The Expert
tagline: A scholar of the unnatural who is rarely the strongest in the room but usually the best prepared, with a haven full of tools and knowledge.
luckSpecial: When you use up a Luck point, you learn that a current event ties back to something you took part in long ago.

moves.intro: Beyond the basic moves you take two Expert moves, both chosen from the seven below. None are free.

choices.name: I've Read About This Sort Of Thing
choices.summary: When you act under pressure, roll +Sharp instead of +Cool.

choices.name: Often Right
choices.summary: If a fellow hunter asks you how to handle a problem, tell them what you honestly think. Should they act on it, they get +1 ongoing for as long as they follow the advice, and you mark experience.

choices.name: Preparedness
choices.trig: When you need something unusual or rare
choices.full: You have it with you right now.
choices.part: You own it, but it is elsewhere and getting it takes a while.
choices.miss: You know its location, but that place is dangerous.

choices.name: It Wasn't As Bad As It Looked
choices.trig: Once per mystery, when you try to keep going despite your injuries
choices.full: Heal 2 harm and your wounds are stable.
choices.part: Choose one: stabilize your wounds, or heal 1 harm.
choices.miss: The injuries are worse than you thought. The Keeper may hit you with a harm move, or make your wounds unstable.
choices.note: You can only try this once per mystery.

choices.name: Precise Strike
choices.trig: When you inflict harm on a monster and aim for a weak spot
choices.miss: The monster gets an opening against you.

choices.name: The Woman (or Man) With The Plan
choices.trig: At the beginning of each mystery
choices.miss: The Keeper gets 1 hold to use on you, putting you in the worst spot with no preparation.
choices.note: Each point of hold lets you turn up in the right place, fully ready.

choices.name: Dark Past
choices.trig: When you trawl through your memories for something relevant to the case at hand
choices.full: Ask the Keeper two of the questions below.
choices.part: Choose one of the questions listed.
choices.miss: You still get one question, but your answer reveals you had a hand in causing the current trouble.
choices.note: You may ask about: lessons from past dealings with this creature or its kind; any dark magic you know that could help; anyone you know of who might be responsible; and any contact who could assist the group right now.

extras.title: Haven
extras.intro: Your haven is a safe base where you can work. Choose three features for it.

options.label: Lore Library
options.detail: Time in your book collection earns +1 forward on investigating the mystery, when history or reference works can help.

options.label: Mystical Library
options.detail: When you prep with your haven's occult books and grimoires, you get +1 forward to use magic.

options.label: Protection Spells
options.detail: Monsters cannot enter your haven. They might find some special way around the wards, but not easily.

options.label: Armory
options.detail: Your haven stores rare, magical monster-fighting gear. When you want a particular special weapon, roll +Weird. 10+: it is there, with extras if quantity matters. 7-9: it is there, but only the bare minimum. Miss: what you get is the wrong tool.

options.label: Infirmary
options.detail: You are able to treat patients and have beds for one or two. The Keeper says how long each patient needs, and whether you need more supplies or assistance.

options.label: Workshop
options.detail: A work area where you build or fix guns, vehicles and other devices. Agree with the Keeper on time needed for each job, and on any extra supplies or help required.

options.label: Oubliette
options.detail: A cell sealed off from all monsters, spirits and magic you are aware of. What you put in can't be located, can't use magic and can't escape.

options.label: Panic Room
options.detail: A fortified refuge with basic supplies and both mundane and magical protection. You can lie low there for several days, safe from nearly everything.

options.label: Magical Laboratory
options.detail: A magical workroom stocked with odd ingredients and equipment for spellcasting, covering use magic, big magic and other magic moves.

history: They are your pupil, apprentice, ward or child. Settle which one between you.
They sought your counsel and it saved them from a bad spot. Ask what the spot was.
They have learned some of your secrets and promised silence. Tell them which ones.
They are a faraway relative. Say exactly how.
You each belonged to the same occult circle, which is now dissolved. Ask why they quit, then explain your own reason.
They helped you get hold of a one-of-a-kind item, which now lives in your haven. Say what it is.
You had the same teacher. Ask them how it ended.
You pulled them out of a dangerous situation. Tell them how it went.
